lines: i rose from the deepest trench
my glow lights up the abyss
i was here before the castles
queen of the loch, at your service
i've seen the stars up close ✨
i blink and the sun goes out
i've been asleep for a thousand years
my scales are older than mountains
i only wail because i care
i'm hotter than the sun's sun
the ground melts where i nap
bow before the king of boo 👑
my cape is also a sheet
drawn to the biggest light of all
the night shift just got an upgrade
nine tails, nine times the magic 🦊
bow before the fox! (jk, pet me)
the sky bends to my wings
they'll never get a clear photo now
